t: 阿贝尔·塔斯曼(Abel Tasman)的第二次太平洋航行从他离开巴塔维亚指挥三艘船起航.
te: Abel Tasman's second Pacific voyage begins as he leaves Batavia in command of three ships.
dz: 阿贝尔·塔斯曼(Abel Tasman)的第二次太平洋航行从他离开巴塔维亚指挥三艘船起航.
de: Abel Tasman's second Pacific voyage begins as he leaves Batavia in command of three ships.

t: 第三次盎格鲁-波沃那战争始于弗吉尼亚殖民地.
te: The Third Anglo-Powhatan War begins in the Colony of Virginia.
dz: 第三次盎格鲁-波沃那战争始于弗吉尼亚殖民地.
de: The Third Anglo-Powhatan War begins in the Colony of Virginia.

t: 清朝皇帝,明中后一任皇帝,在李子诚领导的农民叛乱中自杀.
te: The Chongzhen Emperor, the last Emperor of Ming China, commits suicide during a peasant rebellion led by Li Zicheng.
dz: 从明到清的过渡:清朝皇帝,明中后一任皇帝,在李子诚领导的农民叛乱中自杀.
de: Transition from Ming to Qing: The Chongzhen Emperor, the last Emperor of Ming China, commits suicide during a peasant rebellion led by Li Zicheng.

t: 明将军吴三桂与入侵的满族结盟，在山海关打开了中国长城的大门，让满族进入首都北京。
te: Ming general Wu Sangui forms an alliance with the invading Manchus and opens the gates of the Great Wall of China at Sh…
dz: 明将军吴三桂与入侵的满族结盟，在山海关打开了中国长城的大门，让满族进入首都北京。
de: Ming general Wu Sangui forms an alliance with the invading Manchus and opens the gates of the Great Wall of China at Shanhaiguan pass, letting the Manchus through towards the capital Beijing.

t: 葡萄牙和西班牙军队都声称在蒙蒂霍战役中获胜.
te: Portuguese and Spanish forces both claim victory in the Battle of Montijo.
dz: 葡萄牙恢复战争:葡萄牙和西班牙军队都声称在蒙蒂霍战役中获胜.
de: Portuguese Restoration War: Portuguese and Spanish forces both claim victory in the Battle of Montijo.

t: 满洲摄政多尔贡在山海口之战中击败了顺王朝的叛军首领李子诚,使满洲人可以入关并征服北京都城.
te: Manchu regent Dorgon defeats rebel leader Li Zicheng of the Shun dynasty at the Battle of Shanhai Pass, allowing the Ma…
dz: 满洲摄政多尔贡在山海口之战中击败了顺王朝的叛军首领李子诚,使满洲人可以入关并征服北京都城.
de: Manchu regent Dorgon defeats rebel leader Li Zicheng of the Shun dynasty at the Battle of Shanhai Pass, allowing the Manchus to enter and conquer the capital city of Beijing.

t: 由詹姆斯·斯坦利(英语:James Stanley, 7th Earl of Derby)指挥…
te: Bolton Massacre by Royalist troops under the command of James Stanley, 7th Earl of Derby.
dz: 英国内战:由詹姆斯·斯坦利(英语:James Stanley, 7th Earl of Derby)指挥的王室主义军队所发动的博尔顿大屠杀.
de: English Civil War: Bolton Massacre by Royalist troops under the command of James Stanley, 7th Earl of Derby.

t: 明朝灭亡期间，顺治皇帝领导的清朝满族军队占领了北京。
te: The Qing dynasty's Manchu forces led by the Shunzhi Emperor take Beijing during the collapse of the Ming dynasty.
dz: 明朝灭亡期间，顺治皇帝领导的清朝满族军队占领了北京。
de: The Qing dynasty's Manchu forces led by the Shunzhi Emperor take Beijing during the collapse of the Ming dynasty.

t: 英格兰的查理一世在克洛特雷迪桥战役中击败了议会支队.
te: Charles I of England defeats a Parliamentarian detachment at the Battle of Cropredy Bridge.
dz: 英格兰的查理一世在克洛特雷迪桥战役中击败了议会支队.
de: Charles I of England defeats a Parliamentarian detachment at the Battle of Cropredy Bridge.

t: 英国内战:马斯顿摩尔之战.
dz: 英国内战:马斯顿摩尔之战.
de: English Civil War: Battle of Marston Moor.

t: 詹姆斯·格雷厄姆(James Graham, 1st Marques of Montrose)…
te: James Graham, 1st Marquess of Montrose defeats the Earl of Wemyss's Covenanters, reviving the Royalist cause.
dz: 蒂珀穆尔之战:詹姆斯·格雷厄姆(James Graham, 1st Marques of Montrose)击败了韦米斯伯爵的"约法会",重振了王室主义事业.
de: Battle of Tippermuir: James Graham, 1st Marquess of Montrose defeats the Earl of Wemyss's Covenanters, reviving the Royalist cause.

t: 在1644年9月28日的行动中,一个医院的战列分队击败了奥斯曼车队.
te: A Hospitaller galley squadron defeats an Ottoman convoy in the action of 28 September 1644.
dz: 在1644年9月28日的行动中,一个医院的战列分队击败了奥斯曼车队.
de: A Hospitaller galley squadron defeats an Ottoman convoy in the action of 28 September 1644.

t: 一支瑞典-荷兰分舰队在费马恩击败了丹麦分舰队并俘虏了约1000名囚犯.
te: A Swedish–Dutch fleet defeats the Danish fleet at Fehmarn and captures about 1,000 prisoners.
dz: 一支瑞典-荷兰分舰队在费马恩击败了丹麦分舰队并俘虏了约1000名囚犯.
de: A Swedish–Dutch fleet defeats the Danish fleet at Fehmarn and captures about 1,000 prisoners.

t: 英国内战中第二次纽伯里战役.
te: Second Battle of Newbury in the English Civil War.
dz: 英国内战中第二次纽伯里战役.
de: Second Battle of Newbury in the English Civil War.

t: 顺治帝是清朝的第三任皇帝,明朝灭亡后被封入北京,为第一位统治中国的清朝皇帝.
te: The Shunzhi Emperor, the third emperor of the Qing dynasty, is enthroned in Beijing after the collapse of the Ming dyna…
dz: 顺治帝是清朝的第三任皇帝,明朝灭亡后被封入北京,为第一位统治中国的清朝皇帝.
de: The Shunzhi Emperor, the third emperor of the Qing dynasty, is enthroned in Beijing after the collapse of the Ming dynasty as the first Qing emperor to rule over China.

t: 约翰·米尔顿(John Milton)出版Areopagitica,一本解密审查的小册子.
te: John Milton publishes Areopagitica, a pamphlet decrying censorship.
dz: 约翰·米尔顿(John Milton)出版Areopagitica,一本解密审查的小册子.
de: John Milton publishes Areopagitica, a pamphlet decrying censorship.
